changelog: Major Bluebird transformation with redesigned and polished system experience.
Replaced Material Icons with Microsoft's Fluent System Icons.
Added Mobile Mode to the Start Menu for phone-sized screens.
Added custom XML icons for built-in applications.
Rebuilt the Text Editor into a VS Code-inspired coding experience.
Introduced the new Windows-style BPK application installation and lifecycle system.
Added BPK installation, uninstallation, reinstallation, Program Manager, and Windows-style installer.
Added Bluebird Notes and Bluebird Tasks as BPK applications.
Improved application identity across Desktop, File Explorer, Start Menu, Taskbar, and windows.
Fixed numerous bugs, pin persistence issues, routing issues, and system integration problems.
Introduced R8/ProGuard minification and resource shrinking for a major performance and size optimization.
Reduced the release APK from approximately 24 MB in v1.9 to 7.5 MB in v2.0.
